notes:
Earlier items 1-7 are fixed. Two new clear errors in brief notes that print in the email:
1. Brief 2026-10-24-customers-bank-ai-loan-seven-days, note says "The hours saved come from a survey of employees, and only 5% to 10% of large U.S. companies report a full return on AI tools." Source: "Among large U.S. companies in financial services, healthcare and media, between 90% and 100% report some return on new AI tools. Only 5% to 10% report a full return" and "The June 2026 survey covered 60 senior technology executives at companies with at least $1 billion in revenue, so the figures are self-assessments." The note drops the three-sector scope and the survey basis, and "The hours saved" has no antecedent in the body. Fix: e.g. "Employees said in a survey that they saved an estimated 76,000 cumulative hours, up nearly 65% from the second quarter." (drop the 5% to 10% clause, or scope it to large U.S. companies in financial services, healthcare and media per a June 2026 survey of 60 executives).
2. Brief 2026-10-24-openai-no-live-internet-training, note says "...and OpenAI now trains without it, which matters for any bank letting agents browse." No source says this matters for banks; it is the desk's claim. Fix: end the note after "...two weeks earlier, and OpenAI now trains without it." (source: the policy came "two weeks after its rival, Anthropic, began limiting its newest and, in theory, most capable models from accessing the live internet").
